# Robbe Saelens

> Robbe Saelens is a full-stack web developer based in Geluwe, West Flanders,
> Belgium. He works at Dynamate and builds web applications with Vue.js,
> Nuxt, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Laravel, NestJS and Drupal. This site is his
> personal portfolio.

Canonical site: https://robbesaelens.github.io/

## Identity

- Name: Robbe Saelens
- Role: Full-Stack Web Developer
- Employer: Dynamate
- Location: Geluwe, West Flanders, Belgium
- Languages: Dutch (native), English
- GitHub: https://github.com/RobbeSaelens
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/robbe-saelens-1a14511b8

## Core technologies

Frontend: Vue.js, Nuxt, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, TailwindCSS, UnoCSS
Backend: Laravel, PHP, NestJS, Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma
Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB
CMS & cloud: Drupal, Azure, Netlify, Vercel

## Projects

- [Exulta](https://robbesaelens.github.io/exultadetail): Second version of the Exulta stretch tent rental website, currently in rebranding and not public yet. Catalog, realisations, blog and FAQ on Laravel 13 + React 19 via Inertia, with a Filament 5 admin panel. 
- [VHS Service](https://robbesaelens.github.io/vhsdetail): Trilingual website for VHS Service, an equestrian arena builder in Geluwe, currently in rebranding and not public yet. Next.js 16, React 19, GSAP, WebGL, Vercel.
- [Scan2Talk](https://robbesaelens.github.io/scan2talkdetail): Wellbeing check-in tool for schools, live at scan2talk.be. Students scan a printed QR poster to share how they feel; educators get trends and an anonymous chat. Laravel, Vue.js, Inertia.js, PostgreSQL.
